visualCharacteristics.purpose: image-topped teaser cards linking to services or articles

contentPattern.structure: one row per card; cells: image, body (heading, short text, final paragraph with one link as the CTA). For with-topic-tags, add a read-time line and a bulleted list of tag links

usage: Service teasers on small-business pages, article teasers on home-equity and travel pages.
reuseGuidance: Use with-topic-tags for article cards with tags; light-blue when cards sit on a light-blue section.
